set.body: Found during C4 readiness (voxel-status point lookup). modules/fit .../ResultArtifacts.scala (~lines 179, 191) uses the same resolvedVoxelStatuses-per-lookup pattern C4 fixed in FixedEffects/DenseFmriFitResult; present since base 53097f3f. Fix with point lookup voxelStatuses.fold(Estimable)(_(position)) + allocation test. Also: C3's reduced-rank voxelStatus uses the old pattern (handle in the C3 re-port).
